title: Project Ember – Cascade Outdoor Brands Confidential Information Memorandum
summary: Harris Williams sell-side CIM for Cascade Outdoor Brands ("Project Ember"), a Denver, CO-based premium designer and manufacturer of technical outdoor hardgoods (tents, shelters, ultralight cookware) sold under two owned brands — Ridgeline (mid-market, $95 ASP) and Summit Series (premium, $285 ASP). LTM Apr 2024 revenue of $112M and Adj. EBITDA of $14.0M (12.5% margin). DTC e-commerce represents 44% of revenue, up from 29% three years ago. The Company has 58K paid loyalty members, 3 issued patents, international revenue in 22 countries, and an OEM/licensing royalty stream ($3.2M ARR). Indicative EV implied at ~$175M (12.5x LTM EBITDA). Sale process initiated April 2024; closing targeted Q3 2024.

key_quotes.quote: Ridgeline targets weekend campers and trail runners (ASP $95); Summit Series serves thru-hikers and mountaineers (ASP $285) — Brand separation prevents channel conflict; Ridgeline sold at REI and Target; Summit Series exclusively at specialty and DTC.
DTC e-commerce grew from 29% to 44% of revenue over 3 years; gross margin 15pp higher than wholesale channel.
Subscription loyalty program ('Summit Club') with 58K paying members at $49/yr; 91% year-1 retention.

AeroShield™ fabric technology (2 patents): 22% lighter than competitive Dyneema composites at comparable strength... HexLite™ cookware alloy (1 patent): 18% lighter than titanium with equivalent heat distribution; $3.2M in royalty-bearing licenses to 2 OEM brands.
International revenue +34% YoY, led by Germany, Japan, and Australia; 22 distributor relationships in place.

growth_drivers: DTC e-commerce channel expansion (29% to 44% of revenue over 3 years)
International revenue growth (+34% YoY) with underpenetrated EU and Asia-Pacific markets
Summit Club loyalty subscription program (58K paying members, 91% year-1 retention)
Proprietary AeroShield™ and HexLite™ IP generating OEM licensing royalties ($3.2M ARR)
Japan DTC joint venture in diligence (projected $4M incremental Year 1 revenue)
Premiumization via Summit Series brand (ASP $285, NPS 74)
risks: Manufacturing concentration in Vietnam and Taiwan (4 partners)
Founder-led company with two REI veterans; key-person dependency
Wholesale channel (REI, Target) dependence for Ridgeline brand

title: Project Ember — Executive Summary Teaser: Cascade Outdoor Brands
summary: Harris Williams sell-side teaser for Cascade Outdoor Brands ("Project Ember"), a Denver, CO-based premium designer and manufacturer of technical outdoor hardgoods (tents, shelters, ultralight cookware) sold under two owned brands — Ridgeline (mid-market, $95 ASP) and Summit Series (premium, $285 ASP). The company was founded in 2009 by two former REI product managers and distributes through DTC e-commerce (44%), specialty outdoor retail (38%), and international distributors across 22 countries (18%). LTM Revenue of $112M and LTM Adj. EBITDA of $14M (12.5% margin). Asking price of ~$175M (12.5x LTM Adj. EBITDA). Key highlights include DTC-led margin expansion, proprietary AeroShield™ material innovation (3 patents), and strong international momentum (+34% YoY).

growth_drivers: DTC e-commerce channel expansion (grew from 29% to 44% of revenue over 3 years)
International revenue growth (+34% YoY) across 22 distributor relationships
Proprietary AeroShield™ fabric technology with 3 patents and 2 pending
Two distinct brands spanning mid-market (Ridgeline) and premium (Summit Series) outdoor segments
15pp gross margin advantage in DTC vs. wholesale channel
risks: Supply chain concentration — 4 manufacturing partners in Vietnam and Taiwan
Founder-led business (two former REI product managers)
Dependence on specialty outdoor retail partners (REI, Backcountry, EVO) for 38% of revenue
